title.en: Add and subtract matrices of the same order
Multiply a matrix by a scalar

say.en: Add the sales table for June to the table for July, entry by entry, and you get the total. Double every entry and you get next year's target. That is all matrix addition and scalar multiplication are. In this lesson: Add and subtract matrices of the same order.
Multiply a matrix by a scalar.
Solve simple matrix equations.

body.en: If $A = [a_{ij}]$ and $B = [b_{ij}]$ have the same order, $A + B = [a_{ij} + b_{ij}]$. For a number $k$, $kA = [k a_{ij}]$. Also $-A = (-1)A$ and $A - B = A + (-B)$. Matrices of different orders cannot be added.
body.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ರಮದ A, B ಗೆ A + B = [aᵢⱼ + bᵢⱼ]. k ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಆದರೆ kA = [k aᵢⱼ]. ಬೇರೆ ಕ್ರಮದ ಮಾತೃಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: Add matrices of the same order entry by entry. To multiply by a number, multiply every entry by it. Addition is commutative and associative.
narration.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ರಮದ A, B ಗೆ A + B = [aᵢⱼ + bᵢⱼ]. k ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಆದರೆ kA = [k aᵢⱼ]. ಬೇರೆ ಕ್ರಮದ ಮಾತೃಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

say.en: Add matrices of the same order entry by entry. To multiply by a number, multiply every entry by it. Addition is commutative and associative. A plus B equals B plus A.
say.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ರಮದ A, B ಗೆ A plus B = [a ij plus b ij]. k ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಆದರೆ kA = [k a ij]. ಬೇರೆ ಕ್ರಮದ ಮಾತೃಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

say.en: A plus B plus C equals A plus B plus C.
kA plus B equals kA plus kB.
k plus lA equals kA plus lA.

title.en: Add matching places; scale every entry

say.en: Matrices of the same order are added place by place: top-left with top-left, and so on.
Multiplying by a number k multiplies every element by k.
A 2 by 2 and a 2 by 3 matrix cannot be added: some places have no partner.
A column matrix is an arrow. Adding columns is putting arrows nose to tail.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A = [1 2; 3 4], B = [2 0; 1 −1]. Find 2A − B.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A = [1 2; 3 4], B = [2 0; 1 minus 1]. Find 2A - B.
2A - B = [2 minus 2, 4 minus 0; 6 minus 1, 8 - minus 1].
So the answer is [0 4; 5 9].

problem.en: Find X and Y if X + Y = [5 2; 0 9] and X − Y = [3 6; 0 −1].

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find X and Y if X + Y = [5 2; 0 9] and X − Y = [3 6; 0 −1].

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find X and Y if X plus Y = [5 2; 0 9] and X - Y = [3 6; 0 minus 1].
Subtract: 2Y = [2 minus 4; 0 10], so Y = [1 minus 2; 0 5].
So the answer is X = [4 4; 0 4], Y = [1 minus 2; 0 5].
